name: OsazuwaAkonedo SEO Friendly Category And Tags Related Posts Widget
author: OsazuwaAkonedo

sections.description:
The OsazuwaAkonedo SEO Friendly Category And Tags Related Posts Widget is a high-performance widget built to automate and optimize internal link architectures. By displaying deeply contextual related articles, it decreases bounce rates while cleanly passing search engine crawler equity across your site.

Built-In Smart Fallback Queries

The widget automatically detects the categories and tags of the active post. If specific categories or tags are manually assigned within the widget settings dashboard, it safely locks to those rules across your sidebars and widgetized zones.

Advanced Conversion & Accessibility Engineering

  • Inline Read More Links: Keeps the “Read More” link strictly inline within the post excerpt flow to protect typography layout integrity.
  • Hidden Accessibility Anchors: Injects hidden screen-reader spans containing the full post title. This satisfies modern accessibility demands while strengthening search engine keyword associations.
  • Seamless LikeBtn Integration: Fully optimized with structural checks to render vertical LikeBtn setups immediately below content wrappers using native function checks or custom shortcode triggers.
sections.installation:
Standard Plugin Setup

  1. Upload the entire osazuwaakonedo-related-posts folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Appearance -> Widgets or use the Block Editor to place the OsazuwaAkonedo Related posts widget into any active sidebar area.

Must-Use (MU-Plugin) Setup

  1. Extract the primary plugin file.
  2. Upload the single .php code file directly to your /wp-content/mu-plugins/ directory.
  3. Note: When deployed as an MU-plugin, it activates immediately across your entire ecosystem.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect page speed performance?

No. It hooks directly into the highly efficient WP_Query core framework, pulls minimal configuration array sets, and limits overall overhead.

Can I use this with the modern Gutenberg Block Editor?

Yes. You can seamlessly add this tool inside any block-enabled sidebar or widget layout zone using the standard legacy widget wrapper block.
